controls: every baseline exact saved state, original saved forecast, self patch, locked-anchor identity and final true nohook restoration; plus sign of each direction exact native self patch; minus branches lack extra self replay to respect cell cap

single learned dictionary seed; no training or grid
paired subset15 sources,3/domain; baseline20 sources,4/domain; all sources previously inspected

interpretation.verdict: Branch closed: hidden-space response gains did not improve the prespecified source-mean native forecast response metric.
interpretation.baseline: lambda1 mean baseline distortion8.77% lower than lambda0 but improves only3/20 sources; PCA remains substantially lower.
interpretation.response: lambda1 source-mean sine/noise response NMSE30.16%/23.39% worse than lambda0, although12/15 and11/15 sources improve; retain adverse tails.
interpretation.aggregation_sensitivity: Noise ratio-of-total-energies improves .5369583 to .2744251 while source-average NMSE worsens .7082153 to .8738374. Prespecified source-average remains primary; energy weighting cannot replace it posthoc.
interpretation.pca: Frozen adaptive-support PCA has lower source-average baseline, sine and noise error than either learned arm.
interpretation.scope: Native function preservation only, not forecast accuracy or semantic selectivity. One seed and a fixed15-source paired subset cannot establish a general method result.
